data.gender_notes: Devanshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devanshi means 'Goddess of Gods'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deva' which means 'God' and 'Ansh' which means 'Presence'. According to Hindu mythology, Devanshi is the goddess who incarnates as a human to bring peace and prosperity. The name Devanshi carries the meaning “Goddess of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Devanshi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Devanshi is a name associated with divine feminine energy, prosperity, and strength. It is believed to bring peace, happiness, and blessings to the bearer of this name.
data.etymology: Devanshi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devanshi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

In Hindu mythology, Devanshi is revered as the goddess of divine powers, and her name evokes the sense of a divine and powerful presence. The name is also popular among Hindus and is often given to girls as a sacred and meaningful name.

historical_references.reference: Devanshi is believed to be the name of the celestial goddess, the goddess of prosperity and good fortune, who is also known as Lakshmi. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as sitting on a lotus flower, holding a lotus bud in each hand, and is adorned with gold and precious stones. The name Devanshi translates to 'Goddess of the gods'.
historical_references.context: Hindu mythology, goddess of prosperity and good fortune

historical_references.reference: Another interpretation of Devanshi is that it is the name of a legendary queen who ruled the Sapta Sindhu civilization during the late Bronze Age. She is believed to have ruled during the late 2nd millennium BCE and is known for her wisdom, beauty, and power. Her rule was marked by prosperity and peace, and she is remembered as a symbol of divine kingship.

The usage of the name 'Devanshi' is not just limited to entertainment but is also seen in spiritual contexts. The name is often used in the context of Hindu mythology and spirituality, and is seen as a symbol of power, strength, and divinity.
